question: Consequences for France of new own resources proposed by the Commission for the 2028-2034 period

On 16 July 2025, the Commission proposed new resources to finance the future budget of the European Union and repay the joint debt incurred in the wake of the COVID-19 crisis. In particular, this package includes new resources based on the carbon market, imports taxed on their carbon content, e-waste and a share of tobacco revenue, as well as a contribution from large companies.

The package also includes plans to increase the non‑recycled plastic contribution and to reduce the share of customs duties retained by the Member States. Can the Commission give a clear and detailed indication of the annual cost of each of these measures for France between 2028 and 2034, the total cost for our country and the method used to calculate these estimates?
answer: The Commission presented its revenue estimates per own resource and per Member State, inclusive of the underlying assumptions, in fiches (working documents). The fiches were shared with the Council and the European Parliament in September 2025. These fiches have been produced by the Commission in the context of the ongoing interinstitutional decision-making process in relation to the EU’s future multiannual financial framework and are, as such, not public documents at this stage.
